rules.title: San Francisco allowable annual rent increase (Mar 2026 - Feb 2027)
rules.requirement: Landlords of covered units may raise rent by no more than the Rent Board's published allowable annual increase, which is 1.6% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

coverage_conditions.summary: Units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance; the document does not state coverage conditions.

rules.citation: S.F. Rent Ordinance (Rent Board allowable annual increase)

rules.title: San Francisco security deposit interest rate (Mar 2026 - Feb 2027)
rules.requirement: Interest on tenant security deposits must be paid at the Rent Board's published rate, 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

coverage_conditions.summary: The document does not state coverage conditions.

rules.citation: S.F. Rent Ordinance (Rent Board security deposit interest rate)

rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition, capital improvement, substantial rehabilitation evictions (Rent Ordinance 37.9C)
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner or relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation amounts. For notices served 3/1/26-2/28/27 the amount is $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; max $24,733 per unit; plus $5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child

coverage_conditions.summary: No-fault evictions under Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C where the eviction notice was served 3/1/26-2/28/27.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Applies to evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation. Temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code 1947.9.

rules.interaction: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 rather than Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions (Rent Ordinance 37.9A)
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting tenants under the Ellis Act must pay relocation amounts. For notices served 3/1/26-2/28/27 the amount is $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.

coverage_conditions.summary: Ellis Act evictions where the eviction notice was served 3/1/26-2/28/27.

rules.title: Relocation payments for temporary displacement under 20 days
rules.requirement: Tenant households temporarily displaced for less than 20 days for capital improvement work must receive a daily relocation amount plus actual moving expenses. For notices served 3/1/26-2/28/27 the amount is $446.00 per day.

coverage_conditions.summary: Temporary capital improvement displacement of less than 20 days where the notice was served 3/1/26-2/28/27.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Temporary displacement of less than 20 days.

rules.interaction: Governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
